title: SRE on-call scratchpad — 2026-03-04
content:
03:05 UTC — quick notes from night shift
- Pagerduty page: INC-2026-031 (high error rate on token-service-pool).
  - Alert triggered by 5xx spike + request latency > 1s.
  - Affected region: us-west-2 only (traffic spike correlated with nightly batch job).
  - Initial mitigation: scaled pool from 6->12 instances, CPU dropped but errors persisted on a subset of hosts.

03:20 UTC — triage
- Recreated locally with load test; reproduced increased tail latency when cache-miss ratio > 70%.
- Root cause hypothesis: cache eviction behavior under heavy prefix churn + new kernel path for quantized models causing mem pressure on a subset of instances (g4dn-16xlarge).
- Hosts with errors: token-srv-uw2-07, -09, -11 (all same kernel version).

03:40 UTC — actions taken
- Drained token-srv-uw2-07 and -09, rotated traffic -> errors rate fell to baseline.
- Rolled back recent kernel patch on token-srv-uw2-11 (patch id: KRNL-2026-02-18) -> errors stopped on restart.
- Re-enabled autoscaler to aggressively add capacity for remaining traffic.

Follow-ups / TODO (owner assignments inline)
- [ ] Update runbook section "token-service tail latency" with cache-churn indicators and mitigation steps (Harper) — include command snippets used to identify bad hosts.
- [ ] Open JIRA to track kernel patch rollback and validation for other fleets (Noah — JIRA-SRE-402).
- [ ] Add canary to kernel rollout pipeline to detect cache-related regressions (Lena).
- [ ] Add metric alarm for cache-miss ratio > 60% for > 5m in us-west-2 (Harper / infra-alerts).
- [ ] Postmortem draft: collect logs, timeline, and customer impact summary; aim to publish in 48h (collab: Lena + Harper).

Notes to self (short-term)
- When draining, use --grace 120s to avoid inflight token loss; team page suggested 300s but caused longer failover on batch jobs.
- Use this query to find similar kernel-version clusters: 
  kubectl get nodes -l kernel=KRNL-2026-02-18 -o wide | grep us-west-2
- Helpful log snippet: 
  "error":"kv_cache_eviction_threshold exceeded","host":"token-srv-uw2-11","goroutine":421"

Items to add to runbook (concrete)
- Identification: metric combos (5xx rate, p95 latency, cache-miss ratio) and example alert thresholds.
- Quick mitigation steps: drain hosts by label, rollback kernel via image rollback tag, increase pool size, temporarily route traffic to us-east-1.
- Post-incident verification: run load test targeting suspected pattern and confirm p95 < 300ms for 10m.
- Post-incident checklist: update kernel rollout gating, schedule re-run of nightly batch with lower parallelism flag.

Communication log
- 03:15 UTC: briefed on-call SRE channel, escalated to infra-leads.
- 03:45 UTC: updated status to #incident-status with mitigation steps and ETA for root-cause analysis.
- 04:10 UTC: informed product/support that error spike affected 4% of requests for ~40m window; no customer data impact.

Longer-term tech debt / follow-ups (place in backlog)
- Investigate smarter in-memory eviction strategies for token cache (experiment: LFU hybrid).
- Improve kernel rollout canary metrics to include cache churn signals and tail latency.
- Add synthetic tests that mimic nightly batch churn pattern in staging.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Do we require a kernel rollout freeze until eviction mitigations are in place? (raise to infra PM)
- Can the nightly batch be throttled or sharded to reduce spike? (ask data-platform)

Quick action list for next shift
- Check JIRA-SRE-402 status and ensure nobody accidentally re-applies kernel patch.
- Confirm autoscaler policy change reverted to conservative defaults after traffic normalizes.
- Pair with Lena to update runbook and push PR to confluence page.

Random notes / scratch (ignore)
- Remember to add command used to find top keys causing cache churn (redis top-key snapshot + prefix histogram).
- Postmortem: keep timeline simple, include three graphs (5xx, p95, cache-miss ratio) and a short remediation section.

End of shift handoff: 07:30 UTC to Noah Chen
- Handoff summary: INC-2026-031 resolved by draining failed hosts + kernel rollback on token-srv-uw2-11; remaining tasks are runbook updates, JIRA follow-up, and canary rollout improvements.
- Pending: confirm kernel-patch absent on all token fleets (Noah).
